15d

When the gas is expanding (so when its volume is increasing), the gas is doing work and when the gas is being compressed (so when its volume is decreasing), work is being done on the gas.

Therefore work is being done by the gas during changes AB and BC and work is being done on the gas during change DA.

The total area under the graph during changes AB and BC is larger than the total area under the graph during change DA, so the net work is done by the gas.

 

15e(i)

The entropy of the gas decreases, because by compressing the gas the same number of gas particles occupy a smaller volume, leading to a decrease in disorder.

15e(ii)

The entropy of the surroundings increases, because heat is transferred from the gas to the surroundings, increasing the temperature, hence the disorder of the surroundings.

15e(iii)

The entropy of the universe increases, because based on the second law of thermodynamics, the entropy of the universe increases during any change.
